config.limitation: quentinll/lewm-pusht publishes only the training table (pusht_expert_train / hf://datasets/fracapuano/lewm-pusht/train.lance). There is no official test split. Training fits action normalization on the full table and splits clips, not episodes, so the released checkpoint may still have been trained on these held-out episode ids.
config.full_state_criterion: L2(agent_xy, block_xy) < 20 and block angle < pi/9
config.protocol: joint batch of the original 10 pairs

summary.note: Full-state ever-success is the simulator OR of terminated flags. Wait mode freezes an env on that flag, so ever and final match whenever the success step was recorded. Planning time on each row is the shared batch time divided by 10; mean_replan is per env.
